acceptanceCriteria: A successful current-Runtime typed verification remains complete at the immediately following preflight, gate, and finish evidence boundary when no source files changed.
Runtime governance-only writes do not create a false source snapshot mismatch, while real source changes still make evidence stale and fail closed.
First typed verification semantics, red preflight zero-process behavior, tamper checks, foreign-runtime checks, malformed receipt checks, and symlink checks remain unchanged.
CLI and MCP use the same snapshot and identity binding behavior, covered by focused regression tests and a repository-bound fixture.
The tri-language parity ledger assigns an exact full Work Item id to a retired same-short-id record, preserves its unverified retirement facts, and leaves no ambiguous-short-id finding.
goal: 在无源码变更时让当前 Runtime typed verification receipt 可被后续 preflight、gate 与 finish 正确复用；真实源码变更和身份完整性失败仍严格 fail-closed。
intent: 修复验证成功后 Runtime 自身治理投影导致 typed verification receipt 被误判为 stale 或 contradictory 的生命周期边界缺陷。
outOfScope: Sentinel production code and Signal Context behavior
manual editing or deletion of existing evidence

scenarioCoverage.expected: A successful typed verification remains complete after only Runtime governance writes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a repository-bound fixture through verify then preflight and gate without source changes.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Finish can evaluate the same current typed receipt after governance-only projection writes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the fixture through verify then finish and assert no false stale or contradictory evidence state.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A real source mutation after verification remains stale and fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Mutate a non-governance source file after verification and assert stale evidence with no bypass.

scenarioCoverage.expected: CLI and MCP project the same normalized snapshot and identity decision.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise focused CLI and MCP regression tests against the shared repository service.
